Original files in order: kt01-click-02-01.wav, kt01-click-02-02.wav,
kt01-click-03-01.wav, kt01-click-03-02.wav. Trimmed leading/trailing
quiet to respond promptly to a keystroke. Original sampling rate, bit depth
and level retained. Personal/noncommercial use only.
